title: Read a form value
summary: An input value is the text currently typed into a field.

blocks.text: An input value is the text currently typed into a field. The submit event lets one handler work for a button click or the Enter key.
The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.

blocks.title: Read a form value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.
`textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.

blocks.text: Typing Mia and submitting shows Hi, Mia without loading a new page.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use value for an input, not textContent. Keep the label linked with the input id.

blocks.text: Submit once by clicking and once with the Enter key.
